SELECTED_INDEX: 6
CONFIDENCE: 0.24
EXPLANATION: The strong Raman band at 2123 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a terminal C≡C stretch (typical 2100–2140 cm⁻¹), matching molecules that start with “C#C–”.  Candidate 6 (C#CCCOC1COC1) possesses such a terminal alkyne, whereas nitrile-containing candidates would show their ν(C≡N) nearer 2230–2250 cm⁻¹.  The cluster of medium-intensity peaks at 1058, 1108 and 935 cm⁻¹ is typical of C-O-C stretching / ring breathing modes of 1,3-dioxolane and other acetal ethers, which are present only in candidate 6.  The 814 cm⁻¹ band also fits a ring/ether deformation.  Common aliphatic C–H stretching at 2921 and 2880 cm⁻¹ support the saturated side-chains found in 6.  Altogether, the peak pattern is most consistent with candidate 6 among the listed structures.
